, to achieve reproducible findings, the analysis should be based on a single cleaning method and a single template, and should focus on a single resting state network.

, to achieve reproducible results in clinical rfMRI studies, a cleaning approach based in independent component analysis should be used to remove non neural-related artefacts and a template generated from a healthy control group should be used to perform dual regression.

the use of an appropriate cleaning approach and template can help to increase reproducibility and reduce the risk of false positive findings.
